name: Hardy Lake A Loop
description: Experience this 9.0-km loop trail near Torrance, Ontario. Generally considered a moderately challenging route, it takes an average of 2 h 25 min to complete. This is a very popular area for birding, hiking, and snowshoeing, so you'll likely encounter other people while exploring. The trail is open year-round and is beautiful to visit anytime. Dogs are welcome, but must be on a leash.

rock.rockType: Migmatitic rocks and gneisses of undetermined protolith
rock.rockDescription: Commonly layered biotite gneisses and migmatites; locally includes quartzofeldspathic gneisses, orthogneisses, paragneisses
